subject: Four owner determinations, executed rather than re-escalated, and what each one moved
grantsNothing: These are executions of decisions already made. Nothing here promotes a family, opens a route, enables payment, or creates approval. Every affected family remains generationAllowed false and runtimeSelectable false.
whyThisFileExists: Three of the four determinations moved a fact that already had an operative home, and were written there: the Arizona edition hold and the California county hold live in SOURCE_BACKLOG_CLASSIFICATION.json, the CRM-307 route split lives in the packet-set manifest and the composed-route dependency, and the Utah guidance lives in the family's own build script and delivered artifacts. The California CR-106/CR-401 determination had no such home: the hold it lifts was raised in a lane return, which is history and is not rewritten. This record is that home, and it also carries the one thing a reader cannot get from any of the operative files -- which parts of these determinations could not be executed here, and exactly why.

determinations.subject: Arizona Rule 41 Forms 31(a) and 31(b)
determinations.governingAuthority: Arizona Supreme Court order in R-26-0001, adopted 27 August 2026, effective upon filing
executed: The edition-based legal hold is removed. SOURCE_BACKLOG_CLASSIFICATION.json's az_set_aside-set entry asked counsel to decide which edition governs, on the strength of Administrative Order AO-2025-215 (2025-12-17). AO-2025-215 does not govern the current build and its captainDecision field is now null; what governs is the R-26-0001 text, recorded on the entry.

The SOURCE_REVISION_STALE classification on AOCCRSA3F and AOCCRSA4F is superseded on the record. FABLE-A1 established that the corpus holds the 10/30/2023 editions while az_certificate_second_chance-set names the 01/01/2022 editions, and left the choice between them open. Neither governs, so the choice is not open -- it is moot. That family moves ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE to ACQUIRE_EXACT_SOURCE, because the governing text is not held in any edition.
The held 10/30/2023 binaries are retained in custody as comparison evidence and are unbound. Retiring an edition's authority is not deleting its bytes.

determinations.holdLifted: The source-identity and currentness holds on these three exact forms are lifted. The lane return that raised them asked for 'an acquisition of open bytes or an explicit determination' for the three encrypted California forms; this is that determination. It waives nothing else: mapping, artifact-safety, visual and independent-review requirements all stand, and no family moves state because of it.

It opens each exact source through a pikepdf bridge, saves a derivative that preserves the XFA presence and decoded-packet digest, overlays against measured geometry, and asserts the finished PDF carries no XFA. ca-prop64-set and ca-851-91-set are built through that path and are PASS_COMPLETE awaiting independent verification, so no Rule of Court 1.44 computer duplicate was needed and none was made.

staleMetadataCorrected.whatTheDeterminationExpected: that some record called the held binary XFA while the source index measured it as AcroForm with xfaPresent false, and that the record calling it XFA was the stale one
staleMetadataCorrected.whatTheMeasurementShows: the reverse. The held bytes carry /Root/AcroForm/XFA. pdfinfo reports 'Form: XFA' for all three, and pikepdf opened each pinned binary and found /XFA in the AcroForm dictionary with 48, 2 and 42 terminal fields. The record that disagreed with the measurement was the source index itself, which recorded xfaPresent false for all three.
staleMetadataCorrected.whyTheIndexWasWrong: It measured structure with a regex over the raw file bytes. These documents are AES-encrypted with cross-reference streams, so /AcroForm and /XFA never appear as literal bytes anywhere in the file, and they cannot be recovered by inflating either -- the stream data is encrypted, not merely compressed. The regex found nothing and the generator wrote xfaPresent false: not 'unknown', but a positive claim that the document is not XFA. The same fault produced pageCount null and acroFieldCount null on the same 24 entries.
staleMetadataCorrected.howItWasFixed: scripts/generate-rcap-local-source-corpus-index.mjs now measures a document the primary reader could not open with a second instrument -- the same pikepdf the California packet host already uses on these same binaries -- and records structureReadBy on the entry. Where no Python can import pikepdf the fields record null, because unknown is a worse record than measured and a far better one than a confident falsehood.
staleMetadataCorrected.blastRadius: Only the 24 entries pdf-lib could not open moved, and within them only pageCount, acroFieldCount, xfaPresent and the two new fields. acroFormPresent moved on none. structuralClassObserved moved on none and still reads 'unreadable', which stays true of the factory's own reader and is the field committed source receipts actually pin -- so no built family's artifacts drift. Verified by rebuilding the seven Utah families on the shared host after the index change and getting byte-identical output.
staleMetadataCorrected.alsoCorrectedInTheSamePass: The other 21 entries in the unreadable class -- the remaining California Judicial Council forms and the Delaware, Maryland, Maine, Texas and West Virginia documents -- were measured by the same instrument in the same run, because leaving a known-false field standing on a neighbour while correcting three of them would be choosing which participants get an accurate record.

determinations.subject: Utah acquittal
executed: participant-instructions.md now opens on the automatic route, before any filing step and before any amount. It states that an acquittal on all charges is inside Utah's automatic expungement, the 60-day statutory goal for qualifying post-May 1 2020 cases, and the 120-day processing window the courts' own guidance describes.

It states that there is nothing to file to start it and no request form to send, quoting the compiled profile's record that as of January 1 2026 the court no longer uses the temporary request form that applied from October 1 2024 through December 31 2025 and now identifies and clears eligible cases on its own. It tells the participant in terms not to fill in or send that former form.

It carries the two checks Utah's own screening marks required for this disposition -- whether the case has already been automatically expunged, and the 60-day acquittal check -- and leads the required-before-filing list with the first of them.
It states that on the automatic route the participant does not apply to BCI, does not buy a certificate, does not pay the $150 court filing fee and serves no one.
The petition is reframed as the fallback for a documented automatic-process failure, with the cost and notice sections scoped to it.

The notice sequence for the fallback is stated as the repository establishes it: the participant files with the court, the court gives notice to the prosecuting office, the court sends BCI the electronic Order to Expunge, and BCI informs the available agencies and notifies the FBI.

The BCI applicant sheet's generic copy-delivery language is named as superseded for this route rather than dropped -- its Step 2 'Mail or email the prosecutor copies of what you file' and its Step 4 note that the applicant may also send copies of the order to the agencies. The participant is holding that sheet inside the packet, so a silent omission would have left two conflicting instructions and no way to tell which one governs.

The certificate-fee paragraph now states the acquittal-specific fact the repository holds -- no certificate issuance fee is required for acquittals -- instead of refusing a figure on the ground that BCI sets it per applicant. The $65.00 application fee is unchanged and still stated.
determinations.whatItIsNot: It is not a route promotion. The family stays generationAllowed false, runtimeSelectable false, createsFulfillmentRecord false, opensCommercialRoute false and commercialRoutesOpened 0. GUIDANCE_READY here is the treatment word recorded on the family's own build status; route availability is derived by the launch graph from the Grade-A record registry and was not touched.
determinations.sharedHost: The build script hosts seven families. The change is carried on one config flag set on ut_pet_acquittal-set alone, and the six petition families on the same host were rebuilt and are byte-identical to their committed state, fixtures included.
